Our client, based in Mechelen, is an international leader in medical imaging. You will join a modern and people-oriented working environment where quality, collaboration, and personal development are at the heart of everything they do.

Jobomschrijving

Would you like to work for an international company where technology and healthcare come together?

As a Technical Support Officer, you will become part of a close-knit team, supporting customers with high-quality software solutions for the medical sector. You'll benefit from a comprehensive training programme and plenty of opportunities to grow both personally and professionally.

Your responsibilities as a Technical Support Officer:

As a Technical Support Officer, you are the first point of contact for customers who need technical assistance. You primarily support French-speaking customers, while also communicating regularly in English with colleagues and customers from other countries.

• Provide technical support to customers regarding software, hardware, and connectivity issues.
• Assist customers via phone, email, and remote support, primarily in French.
• Analyse technical issues and work together with customers to find the most suitable solution.
• Guide customers through software installations, updates, and configurations.
• Accurately register and follow up on support requests in the CRM system.
• Escalate more complex issues to specialised colleagues when necessary.
• Work closely with colleagues and other internal departments to resolve complex technical queries.

Who are we looking for?

• You have initial experience in Technical Support, Customer Support, or an IT Help Desk role.
• You have a strong interest in software, IT, and technology.
• You are fluent in both French and English, both spoken and written, as you will use these languages daily when communicating with customers and colleagues.
• You are solution-oriented and remain organised when dealing with multiple requests at the same time.
• You are able to prioritise effectively and manage your workload efficiently.
• A secondary education diploma (A2 level) is sufficient. Above all, we value your motivation, eagerness to learn, and passion for technology.

For our client, a family-run and growing company based in IZEGEM, we are looking for a production worker to strengthen the team. Do you enjoy working with fresh products, are you precise, and not afraid to work in a cooled environment? Then keep reading!
 

Your responsibilities:
 

 
• Cleaning, cutting, and packaging fruits and vegetables
 
• Working according to hygiene and quality standards
 
• Contributing to a smooth production flow
 
• You’ll work in a cooled environment of around 7°C, with appropriate clothing provided 
 

Working hours (full-time):
 

 
• Monday: off
 
• Tuesday to Friday: 7:00 AM – 1:00 PM and 1:30 PM – 4:00 PM
 
• Saturday: 6:00 AM – 12:25 PM 

 
• You speak Dutch or English
 
• You work accurately and hygienically
 
• Previous experience in the food industry is a plus, but not required
 
• You are physically fit and motivated

In this role, you will support a broad range of accounting activities, including invoice processing, bank bookings, reconciliations, monthly closing, reporting and audit support. You will work closely with internal stakeholders and contribute to improving accounting processes. Are you ready for the next step in your career? Don't hesitate to apply.

Your responsibilities:

• Process sales, purchase and general expense invoices in SAP.
• Perform daily bank bookings, reconciliations and account checks.
• Review and follow up on invoices, open items and DMS workflows.
• Process employee expense claims through SAP.
• Support monthly closing, reporting, accruals and reconciliations.
• Prepare documentation for audits and J-SOX requirements.
• Assist with fixed assets, stock counts and other accounting tasks.
• Support internal users with SAP and invoice-processing questions.
• Contribute to process improvements.
• Provide back-up support to the wider accounting team when needed.

Your profile:

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance or a related field.
• At least 2 years of relevant accounting experience.
• Good knowledge of accounting principles.
• Experience with SAP is a plus.
• Good MS Office/Excel skills.
• Accurate, organized and detail-oriented.
• Proactive, solution-oriented and a strong team player.
• Fluent in English and good knowledge of French and Dutch.

Our client is an internationally renowned industrial organization and market leader in innovative technical solutions for customers across Europe, the Middle East and Africa. To support its continued growth and customer-centric strategy, the company is looking for a Customer Experience Representative to strengthen its EMEA Sales & Operations team.

Jobomschrijving

As a Customer Experience Representative, you will be the primary point of contact for a portfolio of B2B customers and play a key role in delivering an outstanding customer experience.Working closely with sales, operations, logistics and finance teams, you will ensure smooth order processing while proactively supporting commercial activities and continuous improvement initiatives.Customer Relationship Management

• Manage and follow up a dedicated portfolio of customers across the EMEA region.
• Act as the first point of contact for customer inquiries and service-related matters.
• Build strong customer relationships and ensure a high level of customer satisfaction.
• Handle customer claims, returns and complaints professionally and efficiently.
• Gather relevant customer and market feedback and share insights internally.
Order Management & Sales Support

• Manage the complete order-to-delivery process.
• Follow up on orders, backorders and delivery schedules.
• Prepare and follow up quotations in collaboration with the Account Managers.
• Provide customers with accurate information regarding pricing, lead times and product availability.
• Support the sales pipeline and contribute to achieving business targets.
• Monitor service performance and customer agreements.
Process Improvement & Operations

• Identify opportunities to improve customer service processes and operational efficiency.
• Collaborate closely with logistics and operations teams to optimize transport, packaging and order flows.
• Contribute to digitalization and continuous improvement initiatives.
• Ensure compliance with internal procedures and quality standards.
Financial Follow-up

• Support the monitoring of outstanding customer payments.
• Collaborate with finance teams regarding credit limits, payment conditions and invoice-related matters.

• Minimum 3 to 5 years of experience in Customer Service, Sales Support, Order Management or Inside Sales.
• Experience within an international B2B environment is a strong plus.
• Knowledge of ERP systems (SAP is an advantage).
• Fluent Dutch and English
• Proactive and able to work autonomously.

An organisation based in Zaventem operating within the property sector.

Jobomschrijving

As a Sales Support Specialist, you play a central role in ensuring a smooth and professional experience for our business partners and internal stakeholders.You act as a key coordination point between Sales, Finance, Operations, and our external partners, supporting the full lifecycle of sales-related requests.This role goes beyond pure administration. You work within structured procedures, but you also think proactively, communicate clearly, and help ensure that everything runs efficiently in a service-driven environment.What you will do

• Act as the main contact person for business partners and internal teams within the sales support scope
• Provide administrative and operational support to the sales team
• Register, process, and follow up on requests and applications through the full workflow, including validation with financial partners
• Manage customer and partner communication via email and web portal, ensuring speed, clarity, and professionalism
• Coordinate with internal departments such as Sales, Order Processing, Finance, and Operations
• Prepare and manage documents using structured templates and standardized procedures
• Monitor incoming and outgoing requests, documentation, and order statuses, and proactively resolve issues
• Ensure strict compliance with internal procedures and company policies, working in a detailed and precise manner
• Support the onboarding of new business partners, guiding them through tools, processes, and ways of working
• Maintain an overview of contracts, ongoing files, and partnership-related communication
• Contribute to continuous process improvement by identifying opportunities to optimize workflows and communication

What you bring to the table

• At least 2 years of experience in a sales support, administrative, or coordination role
• Experience in service-oriented environments such as banking, insurance, leasing, or similar sectors is a strong asset
• A structured and process-oriented mindset, with strong attention to detail
• Excellent organizational and multitasking skills
• Strong communication skills, with a customer- and partner-oriented approach
• Ability to work independently, while also thriving in a close-knit team where collaboration is key
• Languages: Very good knowledge of Dutch or French, with professional working knowledge of the other language
• English is a plus
• Comfortable working with Microsoft Office tools and web-based applications
• No advanced financial calculations required; a basic understanding of financial concepts is sufficient

An international company based in Zaventem is looking for a (Junior) Accountant to join its Corporate Finance & Accounting team. In this role, you will support a wide range of accounting activities, contribute to monthly closing and reporting processes, and assist with audits. You will work closely with colleagues across different departments in an international environment.

Your responsibilities:

• You support internal departments with accounting-related questions, SAP bookings and invoice processing.
• You monitor invoice workflows in DMS and follow up on outstanding items.
• You process general expense invoices, bank bookings and employee expense claims in SAP.
• You support monthly closing, reporting, reconciliations and account checks.
• You follow up on open items, overdue payments and account discrepancies.
• You prepare audit documentation and support J-SOX requirements, fixed asset checks and stock counts.
• You update accounting procedures and contribute to process improvements.
• You provide back-up support for payments, banking, reporting and other accounting tasks.

Your profile:

• You have a bachelor's degree in Accounting or a related field.
• You are a motivated recent graduate or a junior accountant with some initial work experience.
• You have a good understanding of accounting principles and feel comfortable working with figures.

• You work accurately and in a structured way and have a proactive, solution-oriented mindset.
• You communicate effectively with different stakeholders and are a strong team player.
• You are fluent in English and have a good knowledge of French and Dutch.

Part electrical, part mechanical, and no two days are the same. Callewaert Industries Technical Support is looking for an electromechanical technician to join a 2-shift team at one of our clients in the Roeselare area. You'll be employed by Callewaert Industries and work as part of the client's maintenance team.
 

The job
 

•
 You track down and fix breakdowns, roughly half electrical, half mechanical.
 

•
 You keep production lines and machinery up and running.
 

•
 Mechanical repairs and part replacements are yours to handle, and you troubleshoot electrical faults on your own.
 

•
 You log every job accurately and keep the maintenance team in the loop.

•
 You're as comfortable with a multimeter as with a spanner.
 

•
 You've worked as an electromechanic or maintenance technician in a production environment.
 

•
 You work independently and never cut corners on safety.
 

•
 You speak Dutch or English.

For a leading player in the Belgian logistics sector, we are looking for a CE Driver for the Ghent site.

For the Ghent site, we are looking for a CE Driver who enjoys working with a dedicated tractor unit and a flexible day schedule.

Your responsibilities

• Prepare each trip carefully and perform the necessary vehicle checks

• Verify transport documents and ensure load safety

• Couple and uncouple trailers

• Occasionally assist with loading and unloading goods

• Report any issues or delays to the planning team in a timely manner

• Carry out safe and efficient deliveries to customers and the airport

• Contribute to a professional and reliable service

Who are you?

• You hold a valid CE driving licence

• You have previous experience as a CE Driver

• You possess a valid digital driver card, ADR certificate, Code 95, and medical certificate

• You are willing to work a flexible schedule, starting from 5:00 AM

• You are prepared to spend 1 to 2 nights per week in the truck when required

• You are comfortable using GPS systems and other driving support tools

• You communicate effectively in Dutch, French or English

• You are customer-oriented, reliable, and responsible

• Safety and quality are always your top priorities

• You have a genuine passion for transport and logistics

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH
 

Within the EHS team, the Safety Advisor is part of the Internal Service for Prevention and Protection at Work and reports directly to the EHS Manager. The Safety Advisor works with fellow safety advisors to help create a safe and healthy ELC for teammates and external partners. This role collaborates closely with departments across the business, especially the Distribution Directors of the Distribution Centers (DCs) in Ham or Laakdal. The Safety Advisor also partners with DC teams and CPBW members to support continuous improvement in safety and health.
 

WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON
 

You will help protect the well-being of teammates and external partners by advising the employer and managers on safety and health. You will assess workstations and distribution activities, map risks, investigate hazards where needed, and translate findings into practical advice.
 

You will support new installations and processes by providing managers with commissioning reports that are clear, timely, and actionable.
 

You will strengthen prevention by supporting incident and accident investigations, identifying root causes, and proposing measures that help prevent recurrence.
 

 

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR
 

Within the Nike ELC, Environment, Health and Safety (EHS) is looking for a Safety Advisor. This role is part of the Internal Service for Prevention and Protection at Work and supports the employer in creating safe, healthy working conditions for teammates and external partners, in line with Belgian Welfare Legislation.
 

 
 

Your Baseline to Play at Pro Level:
 
 

•  

Safety Expertise. Level 1 certification preferred, or at least three years of hands-on experience at Level 2.
  

•  

Belgian Welfare Legislation Knowledge. Knowledge of, or experience with, Belgian welfare and workplace safety legislation.
  

•  

Collaboration Skills. Ability to work effectively with operational teams, managers, CPBW members, and stakeholders across the business.
  

•  

Independent Working Style. Able to work independently, manage priorities, and connect the right partners when follow-up is needed.
  

•  

Language Proficiency. Fluent in Dutch and English, with clear written and verbal communication skills.
   

 
 

As a plus:
 

Any one of the following can strengthen the profile:
 
 

•  

Machine Safety: Strong knowledge of machine safety principles and how to apply them in an operational environment.
  

•  

Technical Background. A technical secondary school degree, plus ideally experience in a fast-paced logistics environment.
  

•  

Ergonomic Knowledge. Ability to assess ergonomic risks and translate findings into clear, practical improvements.
   

 
 

Other Skills That Step Up Your Performance:
 
 

•  

Facilitation and Reporting Skills. Can facilitate discussions with diverse stakeholders and translate complex information into clear, structured reports.
  

•  

Work Schedule Flexibility. Available to occasionally support outside standard office hours when operational needs require it.

WHO YOU WILL WORK WITH
 

 
 

Within Nike's European Logistics Campus, supply chain is at the heart of the athlete and consumer experience
 

Our ambition is to accelerate service, efficiency and cost improvements by combining data-driven problem solving with end-to-end solution design.
 

Within our organization, there are different teams where you could bring your expertise, with a focus on areas such as transportation, planning and operations.
 

You will work closely with operational teams, analysts, specialists, managers, and internal and external partners across our logistics network. Together, we connect expertise across functions, distribution centers, channels and value streams to improve performance faster and at scale.
 

You will contribute to one strong team, focused on delivering for athletes and consumers while continuously raising the bar in logistics.
 

 
 

WHAT YOU WILL WORK ON
 

 
 
 

• Own and improve day-to-day performance: Monitor supply chain and logistics performance, identify deviations and translate insights into clear actions with the right owners and timing. 

• Turn data into decisions: Combine operational information and analytical insights to identify root causes, opportunities, risks and practical recommendations. 

• Automate day-to-day workflows: Identify repetitive, manual or fragmented activities and help redesign them into simpler, standardized and automated workflows. Partner with process owners and technology teams to define requirements, test solutions, support implementation and track adoption and value. 

• Drive continuous improvement: Structure and deliver improvement initiatives with clear scope, milestones, risks, expected outcomes and measurable business value. 

• Design end-to-end solutions: Work across functions, distribution centers, channels and value streams to connect local improvements to the wider logistics network. 

• Support implementation: Stay close to the operation from problem definition through testing, deployment, stabilization and handover. 

• Build scalable ways of working: Create clear processes, documentation, dashboards and routines that make improvements sustainable and reusable across teams. 

• Engage stakeholders: Facilitate discussions, align different perspectives and communicate progress, decisions and next steps clearly. 

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR
 

 
 
 

• ACT WITH URGENCYYou don’t wait for the perfect conditions. You step in, take ownership and stay close to the action. You turn insights into decisions and decisions into momentum. 

• LEAD WITH HOWHow you win matters. You bring analytical thinking and a problem-solving mindset, challenge the status quo and make the complex simple. You communicate with clarity, bring people along and build strong partnerships across the business. 

• BE FLEXIBLEThe game can change fast, and you’re ready to move with it. You thrive in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment, navigate ambiguity with confidence and adapt as priorities shift. You’re curious to learn different parts of the supply chain and ready to contribute wherever you can create impact. 

• PLAY TO WINYou keep your eyes on the finish line. You focus on solutions that work, value that can be measured and improvements that make a real difference. You don’t stop at the idea. You help bring it to life.  

 
 

YOUR SPORTS BAG CONTAINS
 
 

• A bachelor's or master's degree, or equivalent professional experience, in supply chain, logistics, engineering, business analytics or a related field. 

• You bring a strong interest in supply chain and have built relevant knowledge or hands-on experience through your education, internships, projects or professional experience in areas such as supply chain, distribution, logistics, project delivery or process improvement. 

• Strong project-management skills, with experience structuring work around clear deliverables, milestones, risks and expected outcomes. 

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn complex data and operational information into clear insights and recommendations. 

• Experience identifying workflow improvement opportunities and translating business needs into standardized or automated processes. Experience with workflow, analytics or automation tools is an asset. 

• The ability to work independently while collaborating across teams, functions and organizational levels. 

• Strong communication, facilitation and stakeholder-management skills. 

• Professional proficiency in English. Dutch is an asset. 

• Curiosity, adaptability and a willingness to learn new processes, technologies and areas of the supply chain. 

• Experience with analytics tools, Lean, Six Sigma, Agile, process mapping, simulation or supply chain technology is an asset.  

 
 

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
 
 

• Operational issues are translated into clear actions and sustainable improvements. 

• Manual day-to-day activities are simplified, standardized or automated where this adds value. 

• Projects deliver measurable service, cost, quality or productivity improvements. 

• Solutions are implemented successfully, adopted by the operation and scalable beyond one team or process. 

• Stakeholders understand the priorities, decisions, ownership and next steps.

Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is a subsidiary of Safran Aircraft Engines, based at Brussels Airport (Zaventem & Steenokkerzeel, Belgium), specialized in the inspection, maintenance and repair (MRO) of the advanced LEAP jet engines that power the latest generation of the Airbus A320NEO & Boeing B737MAX narrow body families. The company is a key player in the integrated CFM international MRO network. With more than 75 years of experience, and up to 20 international Part 145 certifications (EASA/ FAA/ CAAC/ …), Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is recognized as a worldwide center of expertise in the air transport industry. More than a 100 airlines, lessors, private aircraft operators and MRO partners have entrusted their engines to our company. We employ over 600 highly skilled, passionate and enthusiastic employees.Join our Technical Department team as a Production Support Technician! In this role, you will be responsible for developing work instructions and methods, as well as providing the necessary production tools to ensure smooth workflow in the workshops and high-quality outcomes for our customers.

Your role:

• You analyze the technical information obtained from the manufacturer via the Engineering department and integrate it into the ERP system.
• You are responsible for writing, updating and translating the technical working documents, taking into account the strict application of the aviation regulations and the instructions of the manufacturer. You ensure the implementation of the technical working documents in the workshops and ensure their correct application.
• You participate in the continuous improvement processes within the department.
• You participate and/or coordinate the improvements of the current working methods and introduce possible new technologies. You ensure the sharing of information as a result of 'retour d'expérience' (RETEX) by means of an infoshop for the mechanics in case of new or improved work instructions.
• You provide technical support to the workshops, both theoretical and practical (if necessary), and look for solutions in case of problems in order to avoid a delay of the production process. You ensure the delivery of the necessary tooling to the workshops and guarantee its correct use by drawing up adequate work instructions.
• You participate in the industrialisation (MRO and NEW) of new types of engines.
• You make repair proposals to the manufacturer in order to make the parts repairable.
• You draw up specifications for the means of production.

Your profile:

• Bachelor's degree in electromechanics or aeronautics, preferably with a first experience in repair methods.
• You speak French or Dutch, with a good knowledge of the other national language and you are willing to improve your skills. You also have a good knowledge of technical English.
• You have good knowledge of electromechanics, mechanics and repair technologies.
• You have knowledge of engines and engine parts.
• You are an analytical and synthetic person and can anticipate.
• You enjoy working in a team, in a multilingual environment and you are willing to support your colleagues.
Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Belgium, holding either an EU passport or a valid work & residence permit. Please note that we do not provide assistance with visa or permit applications.

For our client in Merchtem, we are looking for an Inside Sales Representative to develop business across the Middle East and Africa.Our client is an international wholesaler of industrial sealing solutions, supplying technical distributors and industrial trading partners. Its product range includes O-rings, industrial seals and customised sealing products for a wide variety of applications.The company is looking for a commercially driven professional who enjoys approaching potential customers, developing new accounts and turning opportunities into actual sales.This position has a strong business development focus. You will work closely with the External Sales Representative to expand the customer portfolio across the MEA region while continuing to develop relationships with existing clients.What will you do? 
• Actively identify and approach potential B2B customers across the Middle East and Africa. 
• Prospect for new business opportunities and open new customer accounts. 
• Follow up on commercial leads and convert opportunities into sales. 
• Build relationships with new customers and develop long-term business opportunities. 
• Maintain and expand existing customer accounts. 
• Identify opportunities for cross-selling and upselling. 
• Prepare quotations and follow up on commercial proposals. 
• Process orders and respond to customer enquiries. 
• Maintain regular contact with customers by telephone and email. 
• Understand customer requirements and propose suitable sealing solutions. 
• Work closely with the External Sales Representative on commercial activities and customer development. 
• Monitor sales opportunities and report on commercial progress. 
• Provide professional customer service and ensure timely follow-up of requests.
 
• You have a commercial and/or technical background. 
• You have experience in B2B sales and/or customer service. 
• You genuinely enjoy prospecting and approaching new customers. 
• You are confident initiating commercial conversations and following up on opportunities. 
• You are fluent in English and French, both written and spoken. 
• Knowledge of Arabic is an advantage, but not a requirement. 
• Experience with customers in the Middle East or Africa is a plus. 
• Experience selling technical or industrial products is an additional asset. 
• You are comfortable working with Excel and general business software. 
• You communicate clearly and know how to build professional relationships. 
• You take initiative and are motivated by commercial results. 
• You can work independently while maintaining close contact with your sales colleagues. 
• You are customer-oriented, persistent and organised in your approach.
